title: Young Boy in Hooded Winter Coat on Brick Steps, 1940s B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A classic mid-century black and white snapshot capturing a solemn young boy bundled up in a double-breasted winter coat with his hood up. He sits on the brick steps outside a residential building, looking directly into the camera with a neutral, contemplative expression. The photo features iconic scalloped deckle edges characteristic of mid-20th-century family snapshot prints.
